ModMetaData.name: Emperors and Consuls
ModMetaData.author: hopeseekr
ModMetaData.description:
The playable sequel to CryoRegenesis Royalty endings. Bring a Consul or Emperor through a Stargate (game-to-game continuity). The Empire on the new world already treats you as legitimate. Conquer settlements with a Knight present, loan Knights to hold vassals, and after five RimWorld years send an Archon to make the city Imperial.
Nothing in this mod starts a new story of its own. Court, alliance, and conquest remain inert until a living colonist holds Consul or Emperor — titles CryoRegenesis grants. Stargate is required so that court can arrive from the previous save.
Requires Harmony, Royalty, and Stargate. CryoRegenesis is the source of Consul / Emperor / Hunted Assassin.
